2. 15-inch wood dog sculpture.
3. 30-inch red sunset painting.
4. 25-inch blue cityscape painting.

The second painting subject: "cityscape" or "城市風景"? The subject is "cityscape". Color "Blue". The function expects subject: string. So we can pass "sunset" and "cityscape". The user used Chinese but we can interpret. The function expects "subject" field. So we call painting_create_custom with subject="sunset", color="Red", size=30. And painting_create_custom with subject="cityscape", color="Blue", size=25.

We need to produce function calls. The user wants all four. We can call them sequentially. The function calls should be separate. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we just call the functions.
